text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — MidMarket acct “HarborGoods” flagged: onboarding stalled after P0 import. Renewal in 28 days. They dropped from 85% active usage to 22% in the last week. Thinking a short save plan + downgrade experiment. Need quick ops + enablement sync.
aj_ingram: Ack. Do we have the usage query and the root cause notes?
leo_success: I pulled logs — import job failing on SKU mapping, we retried twice. Customer said they hit API rate limits on their side. Sent them a debug bundle yesterday, no reply.
maria_cs: Customer quote from last call: "We love the model accuracy but onboarding is taking too long — we can't map our catalog at scale." They asked about a cheaper lower-tier option until mapping is stabilized.
nina_pm: @maria_cs can we offer a temporary feature-gated downgrade (read-only ingest + cheaper token cap) while we troubleshoot? We could enable an onboarding office-hour with an eng rep.
aj_ingram: I can carve out a 2hr sandbox slot and run a mapping batch with them. @ops_bot can you provision a support VM and temporary token cap?
ops_bot: IncidentBot: Action created: #SUP-4287 provision-support-vm (owner: aj_ingram). ETA 2 hours.
maria_cs: Drafting the outreach script for the save. Short, must include: empathy, clear next steps, opt-in downgrade, credit offer, office hours link, one-question feedback.
leo_success: Script draft — keep it 4 lines. Use this opening and call-to-action:
```
Hi <CustomerName>, sorry for the friction — we can pause heavy imports and switch you to a Trial-Plus plan (40% cost) while we run a guided mapping session. Would you like a 1:1 office hour slot tomorrow or Thursday? If yes, share 2 preferred times and your sample CSV.
```

maria_cs: Nice. Add a one-click opt-in link that triggers the downgrade and applies a prorated credit. PM, do we have that flow?
nina_pm: We don't have a one-click public flow, but we can manual-apply a promo code from billing. For speed: I can approve a manual credit up to $2k. @aj_ingram will you own the manual downgrade?
aj_ingram: Yes, I'll do the downgrade and pair with them in the office hour. I'll also run this query to confirm usage delta before/after:
```
SELECT user_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_last_7d FROM events WHERE account_id = 'harborgoods' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY user_id;
```
leo_success: Also capture churn risk tags in SFDC: "onboarding_friction", "downgrade_offer", "manual_credit". I'll attach the mapping logs to the case.
maria_cs: Feedback capture form (one question) to send after the office hour: "What single change would have made onboarding faster for you?" Put link: https://redwood-forms.internal/one-q?acct=harborgoods
ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: /remind @maria_cs in 2 days to check reply and escalate if no opt-in.
aj_ingram: Timeline: today — provision VM + manual downgrade; tomorrow — office hour + mapping batch; within 48h — measure usage change and decide keep vs escalate to full onboarding eng.
maria_cs: Success metric to win back: weekly active usage >60% and import success rate >95% post-office hour. If not met, escalate to free migration assistance and extended credit.
nina_pm: I'll pre-approve the $2k credit and keep finance in loop. I'll also draft the customer-facing email template for legal review.
leo_success: I'll update SFDC, add tasks, and tag @support for follow-ups.
maria_cs: Thanks team — action owners: aj_ingram (downgrade + office hour), leo_success (SFDC + logs), nina_pm (credit approval + template), me (customer outreach). We'll reconvene in-thread for status. :thumbsup:
